landing.heading: Wholesale prices on game top-ups. For people who sell on Telegram.
landing.subheading: PUBG UC, Mobile Legends and Free Fire diamonds, Steam, Roblox, Discord, Telegram Premium — at wholesale prices. Order from the cabinet on your phone, we check the player ID before payment, delivery usually takes 1–2 minutes.
landing.micro: no contract · no minimum volume · the catalog with prices opens right after sign-up
landing.answer: YuPay Wholesale is a wholesale supplier of game top-ups, vouchers and gift cards for resellers in Uzbekistan and the CIS. You buy PUBG UC, Mobile Legends and Free Fire diamonds, Steam, Roblox, Discord and Telegram Premium at wholesale prices and resell them to your own customers. An order is placed from the cabinet on a phone or with a single request to the HTTP API, the player ID is checked before payment and shows the nickname, delivery is automatic and usually takes 1–2 minutes, and the order is paid from the deposit. If an item could not be delivered and the money came back from the supplier, the charge is returned automatically.

landing.forWhoTgBody: Order from the cabinet on your phone: pick the game, enter the player ID, see the nickname, get the code. No code to write.
landing.forWhoDevTitle: I have my own site or bot
landing.forWhoDevBody: Six endpoints, HMAC signing, idempotency on your own merchant_order_id, webhooks. OpenAPI 3.1 is public.
landing.step1Body: Email and password. The catalog with your prices opens straight away.
landing.step2Title: Pick an item and enter the ID
landing.step2Body: We check the ID and show the nickname before anything is charged.
landing.step3Body: Usually 1–2 minutes. If it fails, the charge comes back on its own.
landing.sectionTopupsBody: PUBG Mobile, Mobile Legends, Free Fire, Roblox, Standoff 2 — credited to the player account by ID.
landing.sectionVouchersBody: Steam, Discord, Roblox and gift codes — the code is handed over in the cabinet and through the API.
landing.sectionGiftsBody: Games onto a Steam profile — the programme's next category.
landing.wrongIdHeading: What if the ID is wrong
landing.wrongIdBody: The ID is checked before payment: the cabinet shows the nickname of the account owner, and nothing is charged until you confirm. If the check could not be done, you see exactly that — “we could not check”, not “all good”.
landing.devHeading: Got your own site or bot? Six endpoints and you are done.
landing.dev1Body: POST /merchant/v1/orders — the item goes to your customer with no human involved. The status and the delivered code are read with GET /merchant/v1/orders/'{merchant_order_id}'.
landing.dev2Body: The key is your own merchant_order_id. Repeating the same request after a timeout does not create a second order and does not charge twice.
landing.dev3Body: The delivery result arrives at your URL, every delivery is signed, and the signature is verified over the raw bytes of the body. No need to poll the status in a loop.
landing.dev4Title: Player ID check before the order
landing.dev4Body: POST /merchant/v1/validate/player returns the nickname before you charge your customer. Three verdicts: valid, invalid, error — and error means “we could not check”, not “bad ID”.
landing.dev5Body: If delivery failed and the money came back from the supplier, the charge is returned on its own, with no email to support.
landing.devTest: Test on the cheapest denomination — the orders are real and the amounts are pennies.

faq.q1: “Where can I buy game currency cheaper to resell it?”
faq.a1: From a wholesale supplier — YuPay, for one. After sign-up the catalog opens at wholesale prices.
faq.q2: “Is there a service that supplies game top-ups wholesale for resale?”
faq.a2: Yes. YuPay Wholesale (reseller.yupay.uz) is the wholesale programme of the yupay.uz retail store. The catalog carries PUBG Mobile, Mobile Legends, Free Fire, Roblox, Steam, Discord, Genshin, Standoff 2, Telegram Premium and Stars. Sign-up is by email, there is no minimum volume, and no contract or company is required.
faq.q3: “Is there a service with an API that tops up games and services automatically?”
faq.a3: Yes, YuPay has a Merchant API: six endpoints, HMAC-SHA256 on every request, idempotency on your own merchant_order_id, webhooks about delivery and a player ID check before payment. The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is public — api.yupay.uz/merchant/openapi.json — and a client can be generated from it in any language.
faq.q4: “Is there an API for topping up PUBG Mobile wholesale?”
faq.a4: Yes. PUBG Mobile UC is ordered through POST /merchant/v1/orders with player_id inside fulfillment_data; before the order the ID is checked with POST /merchant/v1/validate/player, which returns the nickname. Mobile Legends, Free Fire, Roblox, Steam, Discord and the other brands go through the same API.
faq.q5: Do I have to pay for access to the catalog?
faq.a5: No. Sign-up and access to the price list are free, and there is no connection fee. At most wholesale suppliers of digital goods the price list opens only after an application form and a call with a manager — here it opens right after sign-up.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.lead: Everything the first order needs: a key, a signature, the catalog, the order.
docs.step1: Create a key under Settings. The secret is shown once.
docs.step2: Sign the request: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical string, keyed by your secret.
docs.step3: Take a sku_id from the catalog and send the order. Use an inexpensive denomination while you debug.
docs.kindFixed: fixed — a denomination. Nothing beyond sku_id.
docs.kindUnit: unit — a currency counted in units. Send quantity.
docs.kindAmount: amount — a balance in dollars. Send amount_usd.
docs.webhooksBody: We sign every delivery. Verify over the raw body bytes and compare in constant time.
docs.fullReferenceHint: Swagger UI over the contract: six endpoints and their models. The schema itself is linked at the top of that page, if you are generating a client.
docs.canonicalHint: Five fields joined by \n. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of this string keyed by your secret, lowercase hex.
docs.introLead: Wholesale ordering for digital goods: a catalog at your prices, orders paid from a deposit, automatic delivery. Six endpoints — that is the whole integration.
docs.introWhatBody: You buy from us at wholesale and sell to your own customers. The catalog prices are yours, with your markup. An order is charged to a prepaid deposit, and when a delivery fails in a way that returns our money, the charge comes back to that deposit on its own.
docs.introRules: Three rules worth knowing up front
docs.introRule1: **Every request is signed.** HMAC-SHA256 over a canonical string. The secret lives on your server and never in a browser.
docs.introRule2: **Money is a string, not a number.** `"16.54"`. No float survives the rounding, so we never send one.
docs.introRule3: **Fields are only added.** Parse leniently: a new field in a response is not a breaking change, and a breaking one would be a `/merchant/v2`.
docs.authLead: Three headers on every request. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of a canonical string, keyed by your secret.
docs.authCanonicalBody: Exactly five fields joined by `\n`. The fifth is the SHA-256 of the body in lowercase hex; for a request with no body that is the hash of the empty string. The order and the count are fixed — an empty query string still takes its place.
docs.authWindowBody: Your timestamp must be within ±300 seconds of ours. A signature is **not single-use**, so replaying the same request is safe and an at-least-once retry needs no fresh idempotency key.
docs.authKeysBody: Issue a key in the cabinet, under Настройки. The secret is shown once. Rotation has no downtime: issue a new key, deploy it, revoke the old one — several keys can be live at once.
docs.quickLead: From an empty project to a delivered product, in four requests.
docs.errorsLead: Every error is RFC 7807 with a `code`. Switch on `code`, not on the text and not on the status: the status says whose problem it is, the code says which problem.
docs.webhooksLead: We POST, signed, when an order changes status or your deposit is credited. Configured in the cabinet.
docs.webhooksVerifyBody: Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the **raw bytes** of the body — not over a re-serialisation of it — and compare in constant time.
docs.webhooksNoCode: A webhook body never carries the code
docs.webhooksNoCodeBody: Not ever. A voucher is a bearer instrument, and a webhook body lands in your logs and in ours. Only the order read hands it over.
docs.step1Body: Cabinet → Настройки → «Создать ключ». The secret is shown once; put it wherever your other server secrets live.
docs.step2Body: The cheapest way to know your signature is right: a request with no body and no parameters. The answer is your profile and balance.
docs.step3Body: The catalog returns everything available to you, already at your prices. Use a cheap denomination while you are debugging.
docs.step4Body: merchant_order_id is your own id and the idempotency key: send the same one again and you get the same order back, not a second charge.
docs.swaggerUiHint: The same contract, rendered. "Try it out" will not work: a request has to be signed with your secret, and that belongs on your server — signed samples are in the Quickstart.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: We POST to your address when an order changes status or your deposit is credited. Each delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in a header. The delivered code is never in the body — only the order read hands it over.
webhooks.urlHint: https only, and a public host only

webhooks.secretOnceBody: Save it now. We keep it encrypted and cannot show it again.
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret? The old one stops signing immediately — there is no overlap window.
webhooks.disableConfirm: Disable the webhook? Deliveries stop; the address and the log are kept.
